eyebrow: Microsoft Azure Administration, Compute & Storage · Chapter 3
subtitle: Lesson 12 · Azure Compute: Virtual Machines

code:
az vmss create \
  --resource-group rg-web-prod \
  --name vmss-web \
  --image Ubuntu2204 \
  --vm-sku Standard_D2s_v5 \
  --instance-count 2 \
  --upgrade-policy-mode automatic \
  --lb lb-web
caption: Every instance shares the same image and size, load-balanced automatically.

code:
az monitor autoscale create \
  --resource-group rg-web-prod \
  --resource vmss-web \
  --resource-type Microsoft.Compute/virtualMachineScaleSets \
  --min-count 2 --max-count 10 --count 2

az monitor autoscale rule create \
  --condition "Percentage CPU > 70 avg 10m" \
  --scale out 1
caption: Scale out when average CPU exceeds 70% for 10 minutes, within a min/max range.
